classifier_rationale: The customer made one gas purchase for $61.20 and was charged twice, which is a duplicate charge, a wrong amount.

retrieved.text: Written notice link. After a billing-error intake by phone, send the cardholder a link the same day to submit or confirm the dispute electronically. The cardholder's submission is the written notice under REG-03. The call alone is not. POL-04 does not apply to UN, because notice of unauthorized use can be by phone (REG-12).

Fraud routing. Any charge the cardholder says they didn't make or authorize goes to the fraud team on the same call. Block the card, reissue, open a fraud claim. Agents do not open these as billing disputes only.

What counts as a billing error. A charge the cardholder didn't authorize; a charge that isn't identified properly; goods or services not accepted or not delivered as agreed; a payment or credit not posted properly; a computational error by the issuer; a request for clarification or documentation about a charge; failure to send a statement to the last known address.

note: Cardholder Ivan Delacroix reports two identical $61.20 charges from QuickFuel 214 on 2026-09-29. The cardholder paid for one fuel purchase at the pump, and the receipt shows one $61.20 purchase. No repeated swipe or insert at the pump, and no store purchase. The cardholder has not contacted the merchant. Intent WA: billing-error dispute opened for the duplicate $61.20. Send the electronic notice link the same day per POL-04 (REG-01 billing error). Temporary credit eligible, since the amount is under $250. Unknown: statement date, whether the charge has posted to a statement, and whether written notice was already sent.
